objective: PR3 repair (worktree worktree pr3): fix the rules review's blockers B1, B2, B3, B5 and selected optional findings, without growing the core-rules block.
constraints: Follow the ship brief and writing bar.
The trimmed core-rules block stays at or below 8,540 characters (its current size); a code change in another PR keeps the rules whole ahead of the state summary.
Do not edit the CI watching or Committing sections; do not change the frontmatter tools line.
acceptance_criteria: B1: the solo-root line does not name a tool the root lacks; it says to prefer a file-edit tool over shell rewrites where one is available and to keep each edit reviewable.

B2: the finish rule states that a gate the user waived is named Unknown in the final report rather than counted as Passed, and any other Pending or Unknown result, or a waived gate counted as Passed, is an early stop; the solo line names each waived independent-review gate (for example code or security).
B3: the speak-only list allows a one-line acknowledgement of a new user instruction and the first message of a solo run naming waived gates.

B5: no reference resolves only outside the block (the Specialists table, Sizing work, CI watching forms): name the roster via holyclaude routes, state the sizing rule inline briefly, drop the CI-forms parenthetical.
Optional: routine choices are yours to make without asking; weak-result routing stated plainly; 'After a resume, ask again any question the user left unanswered'; 'reassess the work against it'.
Size reported; format, lint, typecheck and test pass.
